items.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
items.summary: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

items.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
items.summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

items.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
items.summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

items.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
items.summary: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.
